card.name: Frequency words after dose amounts
card.fires_on: The word "each" or a frequency word like "twice" or "times" right after a dose amount or site, such as "2 sprays in" or "tablet". It sits just before "daily" or a body-part noun like nostril.

modes.label: Twice or times before daily
modes.description: A frequency word after a dose or route, right before "daily".
modes.example: Instill four drops into the affected ear<< twice>> daily, for seven days.

card.writes: It seems to lower the odds of words like "consecutive" or "chronological" and favors nothing clearly related.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a dosing instruction where how often (twice, each) comes right after how much.
